name: Flowering of Warmth
source:
"Flowering of Warmth" is a visual novel about a florist meeting new people and helping others. You play as Erica, who is asked to retrieve a herb called "sonnenherb" during the time of witch hunting. Who will you meet and which challenges will you face?

[From [url=https://matsh4.itch.io/flowering-of-warmth-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Flowering of Warmth》是一部讲述花店店主结识新朋友、帮助他人的视觉小说。你将扮演Erica，在猎巫盛行的时代，受托寻找一种名叫“太阳草”的药草。你会遇见谁，又将面对怎样的挑战？

[摘自[url=https://matsh4.itch.io/flowering-of-warmth-demo]itch.io[/url]]
